posts.title: Who's On Your Wing?
posts.description: I've been playing a lot of Ace Combat 8 recently. A lot as in I've been through the campaign four times now, it's that good. One of the reasons I like it so much is that it does one of the things I liked about Ace Combat 7. Revealing the specifics here could be considered a minor spoiler for AC8 (though coming from AC7 I expected it) so I'm putting this break here in case anyone wants to avoid it
